_source: Story 054 (decisions D-059, D-062). How the game is framed and drawn. camera: distance from the play plane in metres (23 shows about 14.5 m of height, so a Vessel is about an eighth of the screen), the height above the feet the camera sits at, look_drop (metres below the camera the view centre sits: small = a flatter, side-on view that shows less of the floor's top), ground_below_m (how much ground the view may show under the room's floor; the ground is drawn deeper than the room so it never shows a void), and the look-ahead; in a boss fight the view sits boss_bias of the way from the player to the boss, never letting the player within boss_edge_m of the edge (story 056). pixel: the game world (not the HUD or menus) is drawn as pixel art: 'height' virtual pixels tall, colour levels per channel, ordered dither strength (0 = none) and outline darkening. The camera snaps to whole virtual pixels so the picture does not crawl.
